description: Flat metadata schema for individual records describing biosynthetic gene clusters, genomic loci, annotated genes, and chemically characterized alkaloids from medicinal plants.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for this metadata record within the dataset.

species_scientific_name.descr: Accepted scientific name of the medicinal plant species, e.g., 'Catharanthus roseus'.

species_genus.descr: Genus name of the plant species.

species_specific_epithet.descr: Specific epithet of the plant species.

plant_family.descr: Taxonomic family of the plant species, e.g., Apocynaceae.

voucher_specimen_id.descr: Herbarium or voucher specimen identifier used to authenticate the plant material.

sample_tissue.descr: Plant tissue or organ used for sequencing or metabolite extraction, e.g., leaf, root, stem, bark, seed.

sample_condition.descr: Biological condition of the sample, such as developmental stage, treatment, or stress state.

geographic_origin.descr: Geographic origin of the sampled plant material, preferably in standardized locality format.

genome_assembly_accession.descr: Genome assembly accession or internal assembly identifier used for locus mapping.

chromosome_or_scaffold.descr: Chromosome, contig, or scaffold name where the biosynthetic locus is located.

locus_start_bp.descr: Start coordinate of the biosynthetic locus on the assembly, in base pairs.

locus_end_bp.descr: End coordinate of the biosynthetic locus on the assembly, in base pairs.

locus_strand.descr: Strand orientation of the locus or gene annotation, use '+' or '-'.

biosynthetic_gene_cluster_id.descr: Identifier assigned to the biosynthetic gene cluster.

cluster_type.descr: General cluster category, e.g., alkaloid biosynthetic cluster, terpene-alkaloid hybrid cluster, or other relevant classification.

cluster_size_genes.descr: Number of genes annotated within the biosynthetic gene cluster.

cluster_contains_PKS.descr: Indicates whether the cluster contains a polyketide synthase gene.

cluster_contains_P450.descr: Indicates whether the cluster contains one or more cytochrome P450 genes.

gene_ids.descr: Comma-separated list of gene identifiers assigned to genes in the cluster.

gene_names.descr: Comma-separated list of gene names or locus tags associated with the cluster genes.

gene_functions.descr: Functional annotations for cluster genes, e.g., methyltransferase, oxidoreductase, aminotransferase, N-methyltransferase.

gene_family_annotations.descr: Protein family or domain annotations for the cluster genes, e.g., PFAM or InterPro labels.

annotation_method.descr: Method used to annotate the genes, such as manual curation, homology search, HMM-based annotation, or pipeline name.

annotation_confidence.descr: Confidence level for the cluster or gene annotation, expressed as a categorical string such as low, medium, high, or a numeric score if used.

evidence_code.descr: Evidence supporting the cluster-gene-pathway assignment, e.g., transcriptomics, coexpression, orthology, knockout, enzyme assay, metabolite correlation.

transcriptomic_support.descr: Indicates whether transcriptomic evidence supports the cluster assignment or pathway activity.

metabolomic_support.descr: Indicates whether metabolomic evidence supports the presence of the predicted alkaloid product.

alkaloid_name.descr: Name of the alkaloid chemically associated with this record, e.g., vinblastine, morphine, berberine.

alkaloid_class.descr: Alkaloid subclass or structural class, e.g., indole, isoquinoline, tropane, quinoline, pyrrolizidine.

alkaloid_formula.descr: Molecular formula of the characterized alkaloid, when known.

alkaloid_monoisotopic_mass.descr: Monoisotopic mass of the alkaloid in Daltons (Da), if measured or calculated.

alkaloid_retention_time_min.descr: Chromatographic retention time of the alkaloid in minutes, if available.

alkaloid_purity_percent.descr: Estimated purity of the isolated compound, in percent (%).

analytical_method.descr: Analytical chemistry method used for characterization, e.g., LC-MS/MS, GC-MS, NMR, HPLC, FTIR.

instrument_model.descr: Instrument model used for chemical characterization, e.g., Orbitrap, QTOF, NMR spectrometer model.

fragmentation_mode.descr: Ionization or fragmentation mode used for mass spectrometry, e.g., positive mode, negative mode, CID, HCD.

metabolite_source.descr: Source of the characterized metabolite, such as plant extract, purified compound, or heterologous expression product.

pathway_step.descr: Ordered step or position of the gene/enzymatic reaction within the biosynthetic pathway, if assigned.

enzyme_ec_number.descr: Enzyme Commission number for the annotated enzyme, if applicable.

substrate_name.descr: Substrate used by the enzyme or pathway step, if known.

product_name.descr: Product generated by the enzyme or pathway step, if known.

reaction_type.descr: Biochemical reaction category, e.g., methylation, oxidation, cyclization, prenylation, glycosylation.

expression_evidence.descr: Summary of expression evidence for the gene or cluster, such as upregulated in tissue, coexpressed with pathway markers.

functional_validation.descr: Indicates whether the gene or pathway has been functionally validated experimentally.

validation_method.descr: Experimental validation method, if performed, e.g., heterologous expression, enzyme assay, gene knockout, complementation.

publication_doi.descr: Digital Object Identifier of the publication describing this record, if available.

data_repository_accession.descr: Accession or identifier in a public repository for linked sequence, assembly, or metabolomics data.

curation_status.descr: Curation state of the record, e.g., raw, processed, annotated, manually curated, validated.

record_date.descr: Date when the record was created or last updated.
